_readme: THE BULLET LANDS (SOUNDS 10/24/26, row [the bullet lands], rule 120): where the bullet goes, from real recordings, through the guns' own street, camcorder and tape (tools/bohemia_bullet_lands.py). ONE sprite, lands.mp3: every take of every voice at its own at_s, dur_s long. The game's player is engine/bohemia_bullet_lands.js.
chain: layers > street canyon 20 m (an echo every 16th) > camcorder AGC (2 ms / 500 ms / up to +6 dB) > tape > VHS band 100 Hz to 10 kHz > cut, a 16th fade > one loudness per voice
